## Declaration of use of content generated by Artificial Intelligence (AI)

The authors acknowledge the use of content generated by Artificial Intelligence (AI)
(including but not limited to text, figures, images, and code) in the paper entitled
"Enhancing Digital Education Using VR Technology" in the following ways: to assist with
literature discovery and synthesis during the systematic literature review, and to assist
with the implementation and maintenance of the reproducible analytics pipeline. The
research team remained responsible for all study design, data analysis, and interpretation
of results, and maintains full accountability for the integrity and originality of the
final manuscript.
